newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BOURSE MIXED, BANKING SECTOR MORE ACTIVE.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE MIXED, BANKING SECTOR MORE ACTIVE.

text.p: Lithuanian shares remained mixed at the morning fix although banking sector showed some rapid moves on the slow market, dealers said.
"Today five shares inched up, five fell, six remained stabile and the rest were still floating in morning trade," Arvydas Jacikevichius, a broker with Suprema brokerage, told Reuters.
Dealers said the trade in bank shares was more active although prices remained unchanged. Siauliu Bank was the exception with a 7.05 percent rise to 85 litas.
"There were two orders, for 1000 and 500 ordinary shares, for Vilniaus Bank at 235 litas price," Aiste Kraujalyte, a broker with Vilfima brokerage said.
"The growing demand for Vilniaus Bank may be influenced by the fact that the investors are expecting good results for the first half of the year," Kraujalyte added.
Another leader of the banking market, Hermis Bank, edged up to 186 litas from 185 litas.
Kraujalyte also said that the turnover of TV screens producer Ekranas may be high on Monday as around 12,000 shares were sold in the morning.
"At the 5.52 litas price Ekranas shares are attractive to investors and today demand exceeded the offer considerably," Kraujalyte said.
Ekranas inched up to 5.52 litas from 5.51 litas on Monday.
Baltijos Shipayrd remained unchanged at 7.95 litas and Birzhai Milk stayed steady at 9 litas.
